_comment: Shared first-name pool for the two-character worked-example slots ({{learner-a}} = the weaker/negative example, {{learner-b}} = the stronger/positive example). merge-context.js picks two distinct names from this pool per course, deterministically (seeded by the course slug) so builds stay stable. A pack's context.json may still set a single {{character.name}}; these learner-a/b slots are separate and always pool-filled. Each entry carries a pronoun and possessive so third-person prose can use {{learner-a-pronoun}}/{{learner-a-possessive-pronoun}} (and the b- equivalents) instead of being pronoun-free. Names chosen to be short, varied and inclusive; add/remove freely.
